metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds fourteen shillings, a cup half-raised, and Old Swan stairs.

yesterday: Monday is Errors, and you play. Friday is Richard the Third on the bill. Saturday is the old Hamlet, and you play.
Kemp found that a smaller pause got the laugh. You took the timing home.
Davy said the Queen is at Greenwich with five thousand men, the Rose shut till Christmas, and thunder coming. You stayed at the stairs until the moon.
